method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, reverse paraphrase of every proposition and proof, stepwise replay of all 9 encoded tableaux and their closure witnesses, exact formula, macro, token and identifier comparison after documented source projections, and enumeration-count comparison; no independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Basic propositional consequences for tableau derivability: conjunction projections and introduction, inconsistency of a disjunction with both negations, disjunction introductions, modus ponens, and two sufficient conditions for a conditional.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The section says tableau derivability is strong enough for the propositional facts needed in completeness, including extracting A from A-and-B and applying modus ponens. The first proposition states both conjunction projections and derivation of A-and-B from A and B.
samples.checks: The connective names, all five derivability formulas, modus-ponens parenthesis and completeness role are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Two closed tableaux prove the conjunction projections: true A-and-B supplies true A and true B, closing against false A or false B. A third tableau starts with true A, true B and false A-and-B; the two false-conjunction branches close against the corresponding true assumptions.
samples.checks: All three trees preserve assumptions, branch order, rule references and closure pairs. OLTAB-010 repairs four malformed signed-formula argument boundaries without changing their signs or atoms.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A-or-B together with not-A and not-B is inconsistent, and either A or B separately derives A-or-B. The first tableau derives false A and false B from the two true negations and closes both true-disjunction branches. The next two tableaux expand false A-or-B into false A and false B and close against the supplied true A or true B.
samples.checks: All three trees preserve the true/false signs, nonbranching false-disjunction expansion, branching true-disjunction expansion and closure witnesses. OLTAB-010 repairs the four malformed false-node argument boundaries.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: For conditionals, A with A-implies-B derives B. Also not-A alone and B alone each derive A-implies-B. The modus-ponens tableau branches true A-implies-B into false A or true B and closes both. A false conditional supplies true A and false B; with true not-A the first auxiliary tableau derives false A, while with true B the second closes on B.
samples.checks: All three conditional trees preserve formula order, signs, rule labels, line references, branch structure and both closing pairs.

source_observations: OLTAB-010 documents eight malformed signed-formula macro calls and the bounded restoration of their required truth-sign/formula argument boundary.

The first conjunction tableau marks closure after both conjunction products have been placed, although its false-A/true-A contradiction already occurs at the preceding node; the completed branch is still closed and no correction is required.
The unit contains 9 oltableau environments and 12 enumerated items in both source and target.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
The tableau and propositional proof vocabulary remains subject to the existing expert-review ledger where exact specialist Marathi attestation is sparse.
Visual placement of the repaired tree nodes will be inspected in the guarded cumulative chapter build.
